missions.title: Mission 1 - The First Molecules
missions.subtitle: Introduce simple compounds and observe Brownian motion and collisions.
missions.what_model_captures: Thermal Brownian motion scaled by temperature and viscosity, elastic collisions, and local concentration fields.
missions.what_remains_unknown: Full quantum-mechanical electronic orbitals and explicit solvent hydrogen-bond networks are abstracted.

missions.title: Mission 2 - Resource Competition
missions.subtitle: Seed two artificial lineages in a shared basin and watch competition for limited substrate.
missions.what_model_captures: Differential substrate uptake, energetic maintenance cost, and competitive exclusion.
missions.what_remains_unknown: Artificial replicators represent an abstract toy chemistry, not living biological cells.

missions.title: Mission 3 - 100 Generations of Evolution
missions.subtitle: Accelerate evolutionary time across 100 generations and inspect the emerging family tree.
missions.what_model_captures: Heritable trait variation, lineage branching, extinction events, and Shannon diversity.
missions.what_remains_unknown: Virtual generations do not map linearly onto geological or clinical timescales.

missions.title: Mission 4 - Environmental Survival
missions.subtitle: Shift temperature or pH and observe which chemical families persist across niches.
missions.what_model_captures: Arrhenius thermal sensitivity, pH rate modulation, and niche-specific persistence.
missions.what_remains_unknown: Macroscopic phase transitions and precipitation kinetics are simplified.

missions.title: Mission 5 - The Virtual Pancreatic Tumor
missions.subtitle: Open the 2D PDAC microenvironment and observe tumor proliferation, stromal CAFs, and hypoxia.
missions.what_model_captures: Oxygen/nutrient reaction-diffusion, hypoxic core formation, desmoplastic CAF stroma, and heterogeneous subclones.
missions.what_remains_unknown: A 2D tissue slice cannot replicate whole-organ vascular architecture, metastasis, or patient immunology.

missions.title: Mission 6 - Controlled Compound Testing
missions.subtitle: Compare an untreated control tumor against a reference compound under identical initial conditions.
missions.what_model_captures: Free vs. protein-bound concentration, stromal diffusion hindrance, and concentration-dependent apoptosis.
missions.what_remains_unknown: In silico cell-kill never proves human clinical safety or therapeutic benefit.

missions.title: Mission 7 - Clonal Resistance
missions.subtitle: Observe how sensitive and resistant PDAC subclones respond differently to selective pressure.
missions.what_model_captures: Efflux-mediated lower intracellular exposure and competitive expansion of less sensitive subclones.
missions.what_remains_unknown: Real clinical resistance involves complex epigenetic, stromal, and systemic adaptations.

missions.title: Mission 8 - Multi-Objective Balance
missions.subtitle: Balance predicted antitumor activity, selectivity over healthy cells, ADMET, and toxicological uncertainty.
missions.what_model_captures: Pareto trade-offs between potency, healthy-cell sparing, solubility, and structural toxicity alerts.
missions.what_remains_unknown: Computational rankings only prioritize hypotheses for wet-lab testing; they never establish clinical dosing.

achievements.title: First Valid Transformation
achievements.description: Observed a stoichiometrically conserved chemical reaction in the 2D universe.

achievements.title: Deep Lineage Historian
achievements.description: Evolved an ecosystem past 100 generations and traced a molecule back to its founder.

achievements.title: Controlled Experimentation
achievements.description: Ran a side-by-side untreated control before interpreting compound effects.

achievements.title: Selectivity Over Raw Potency
achievements.description: Evaluated healthy epithelial cell sparing and toxicological uncertainty alongside tumor inhibition.

achievements.title: Pareto Frontier Navigator
achievements.description: Completed a multi-objective NSGA-II candidate optimization run within the applicability domain.

glossary.simple: A structural or heritable change that produces a new variant.
glossary.technical: Stochastic operator altering heritable replicator traits (Mode A) or applying RDKit valence-validated structural edits (Mode B).

glossary.simple: Some variants persist and leave more descendants than others under environmental constraints.
glossary.technical: Emergent differential reproduction and survival arising from resource uptake, catalytic rate, and decay kinetics.

glossary.simple: The capacity of a substance to damage or kill cells (including healthy cells).
glossary.technical: Concentration-dependent loss of cellular viability quantified via Hill Emax/IC50 pharmacodynamics across target and non-target cells.

glossary.simple: The ability of certain cancer cells to survive despite exposure to a compound.
glossary.technical: Multi-factor attenuation of drug response driven by efflux pumps, pathway alterations (e.g., KRAS/TP53/CDKN2A/SMAD4 context), and stromal shielding.

glossary.simple: The natural spreading of molecules from higher to lower concentration.
glossary.technical: Fickian spatial transport governed by dC/dt = D * Laplacian(C), scaled by Stokes-Einstein diffusivity and ECM hindrance.
Regulated cellular death pathway triggered when intracellular pharmacodynamic stress exceeds clone-specific survival thresholds.

glossary.simple: Regions inside a tissue or tumor with dangerously low oxygen levels.
glossary.technical: Microenvironmental zones where cellular O2 consumption outpaces vascular diffusive supply (local normalized O2 < 0.30).

glossary.simple: Only the unbound fraction of a compound can freely cross membranes and reach its target.
glossary.technical: Distinction between applied concentration C_applied, unbound extracellular C_free = fu * C_total, and intracellular AUC.

glossary.simple: Whether a new molecule is structurally similar enough to known data for a model's estimate to be trustworthy.
glossary.technical: Nearest-neighbor Morgan fingerprint Tanimoto similarity threshold against the reference training set.

glossary.simple: The set of best-balanced candidates where improving one goal would worsen another.
glossary.technical: Non-dominated solution set under NSGA-II multi-objective optimization across potency, selectivity, QED, toxicity risk, and AD confidence.

tutorial_steps.title: Welcome to the Chemical Universe
tutorial_steps.body: This 2D world simulates real molecular descriptors, Brownian physics, and evolution - locally on your machine.

tutorial_steps.title: Add Your First Compound
tutorial_steps.body: Pick a molecule from the left library (or drag it onto the canvas) to introduce it into the environment.

tutorial_steps.title: Start Simulation Time
tutorial_steps.body: Press Play or Step to watch Brownian motion, diffusion fields, and molecular collisions unfold.

tutorial_steps.title: Observe Chemical Reactions
tutorial_steps.body: When compatible molecules collide with sufficient energy, they transform or form complexes under explicit rules.

tutorial_steps.title: Inspect Any Entity
tutorial_steps.body: Click any particle or cell on the canvas to view its 2D chemical structure, properties, and epistemic tags.

tutorial_steps.title: Explore the Family Tree
tutorial_steps.body: Open the Family Tree view to trace descendants back to their founder molecules, including extinct lineages.

tutorial_steps.title: Accelerate Generations
tutorial_steps.body: Use 10x, 100x, or batch evolution presets (100+ generations) to study long-term selection and diversity.

tutorial_steps.title: Enter Cancer Battle (PDAC)
tutorial_steps.body: Switch to Cancer Battle to inspect a virtual pancreatic tumor with sensitive clones, resistant clones, CAFs, and hypoxia.

tutorial_steps.title: Compare Control vs. Exposure
tutorial_steps.body: Run Compare Worlds to test a compound against an untreated control with the exact same random seed.

tutorial_steps.title: Save & Switch PLAY <-> LAB
tutorial_steps.body: Save reproducible checkpoints anytime, and toggle between PLAY and LAB at the top bar without losing state!
